pages.title: The Spell Wheel
pages.text: Hold $(k:key.hollowmancy.cycle_spell) to open the wheel.$(br2)The $(l)inner ring$() holds your schools of magic. Point at one, and its spells fill the $(l)outer ring$(). Move outward onto a spell and let go.$(br2)Tap the key instead to keep the wheel open, then click. Scroll to step through spells; hold Shift to step through schools.

pages.title: Quick Slots
pages.text: While pointing at a spell in the wheel, press $(l)1$() to $(l)5$() to place it in a quick slot. Press the same number again to clear it.$(br2)Then $(k:key.hollowmancy.spell_slot_1) through $(k:key.hollowmancy.spell_slot_5) cast those spells at once, without changing the spell you have selected. Your slots sit above the mana bar.
